SSC CGL Tier-II Final Answer Key / Marks 2026

Post Date: June 18, 2026

5:14 pm

Staff Selection Commission (SSC), has released the Tier-II Final Answer Key / Marks on the official website for the SSC Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025. The Tier-II exam was conducted on 18-19 January 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 05 July 2025. Candidates can check their Tier-II Final Answer Key using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
